modes.N1: uniform prices, original ranking and C1
modes.N2: heterogeneous fixed public offers: price then complete old tie-break
modes.N3: same N2 setup, only local posted-price updates

mapping.shutdown: Round6 G (one surviving steel supplier, fixed topology)

scale.S20: double S10 groups via existing deterministic ring method:10 raw,20 steel,40 machine=70 active;degree<=2;per-firm parameters unchanged

prices.heterogeneous: alternating canonical producer IDs at base or 90% of base; no seller hidden information
prices.currency: integer laboratory units; no real currency conversion

funding.nonbinding: per account upper bound: initial purchasable inventory + days * conservative global production/input/demand quantity upper bound, multiplied by maximum allowed price; each account independently covered, no revenue assumed
funding.finite: per firm 20 days of its own capacity input cost at safety price bound + initial inventory replenishment allowance; per sink 20 days max declared demand * terminal price; never recharge

candidate.rounding: floor 2% to tick multiple; hold if step<tick; lower bound ceiling(initial/4) to tick, upper=4*initial
candidate.formula: if no received new information:hold; if own free inventory >= 2*max(window shipped,1):down; else if price/cash refusals and free inventory>0:down; else if distinct physical unmet>0 and shipped>0 and free inventory<shipped:up; else hold
candidate.request_dedup: max unresolved quantity per (buyer,need_id,reason) in completed window, expiry by need_by_day; retries never sum

held_evaluation: main/long/scale fixtures; correctness inspection permitted; no tuning on their model output
replays: two independent processes of the complete main+long+scale formal configuration set; performance excluded from economic hashes
